text: Runtime registration behavior is documented through `register(type, name, impl, manifest)`, `set_default(type, name)`, `resolve(type, name?)`, and `list(type)`. Manifest or interface validation failures are documented as startup errors with code `ADAPTER_INTERFACE_MISMATCH`, including `type`, `name`, `required_interface_version`, `detected_interface_version`, and `remediation`; required adapters hard-fail startup, while optional adapters may continue in degraded mode when safe. The document explicitly notes that required adapters include worker and store interfaces.
